mechanism: Lopinavir (potent CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase vedolizumab exposure through inhibition of metabolic pathways, while vedolizumab's immunosuppressive effects combined with lopinavir's use in immunocompromised patients increases infection risk.
action: Monitor for increased vedolizumab adverse effects and enhanced immunosuppression; ensure appropriate infectious disease prophylaxis and clinical monitoring in HIV-positive patients on combination therapy.
